feeds.title: Land8
feeds.description: Land8 is the social and information hub for landscape architecture for students, emerging professionals, and seasoned landscape architects.

feeds.title: Landscape Architecture Magazine
feeds.description: Founded in 1910, Landscape Architecture Magazine (LAM) is the monthly magazine of the American Society of Landscape Architects. Their mission is to elevate the practice of landscape architecture by providing timely information on built landscapes and on new techniques for ecologically sensitive planning and design.

feeds.title: The Dirt
feeds.description: THE DIRT blog covers the latest news on the built and natural environments and features stories on landscape architecture. Published weekly, THE DIRT explores design and policy developments related to land and water use, urbanization, transportation, and climate change.

feeds.title: Land8 Blog
feeds.description: Land8.com's misssion is to build up the profession of landscape architecture by strengthening the international community through the sharing of ideas, individual work, and information related to the field of landscape architecture.

feeds.title: Landscape Australia

feeds.title: Surrounds Landscape Blog

feeds.title: Secret Gardens

feeds.description: The LAA website aims to showcase and debate landscape architecture, to campaign for improvements to the urban landscape of London and other locales and to provide a forum for the discussion of past and future landscape architecture projects in the context of their history and theory.

feeds.title: Oehme, van Sweden

feeds.title: David Rubin

feeds.title: Landworks Studio Blog

The NJASLA works hard to provide local services to NJ member Landscape Architects.

feeds.title: Arcadia

feeds.title: Forrec Designs

feeds.title: The landscape

feeds.title: Liz Lake Associates

feeds.title: Topos Magazine

feeds.title: TLS
